name: text-outline-fill-sweep
title: Outline To Fill Sweep
description: Chữ hiện bằng nét viền trước, sau đó phần ruột được tô đặc quét từ trái sang phải trong 1 giây.

moworks.author: moworks

options.delay: s from the outline's start to the fill (0.7)
options.line: px of the accent edge line (4)
options.exit: s after the start: the fill wipes off left to right in 0.6 s, then the outline fades (null: stay)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Outline copy (transparent fill, stroke min(2 px, 0.035 em)) fades in and its stroke grows over 0.5 s (demo 0.2–0.7 s), staying on top. The filled copy underneath is revealed by clip inset(right 100 % → 0) over 1 s ease-in-out (CSS (.42,0,.58,1); demo (.65,0,.35,1)), starting 0.7 s after the outline (CSS delay 0.3 s); a 2 px accent line marks the sweep edge. Exit: the fill wipes off left → right (0.6 s), then the outline fades. Loop 4.2 s. Params: stroke: nét viền (2 px) · delay: tô sau viền (0.7 s) · duration: quét tô (1 s) · ease (ease-in-out).
moworks.titleVi: Viền chữ trước, ruột tô sau
